notes.content:
Happy Birthday MaCaw!
Captain MaCaw is 5 this week!

Updated the store art and patched the main game.

[list]
[*]Re done the front end and instructions screen to look better and align with the new store art.
[*]Various spelling errors in chat text resolved.
[*]Fixed some anti-aliased text that should not have been anti-aliased.
[*]Made jumping up the trees in the woods a little more forgiving.
[*]Made the "Butterfly tree" easier to land on and harder to fall off.
[*]Varied the animation speed of the butterflies.
[*]Made yellow objects easier to see if dropped against the yellow tree.
[*]Made an optional item easier to find.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11 released
notes.content:
1.11 released fixing the following bugs.

[list]
[*]Game breaking bug where if you saved at 1 certain point in the game and quit, it did not save the player status and prevented progress.
[*]Hidden achievement that should trigger after the end sequence played moved to the start of the end sequence to fix a rare bug where it would not trigger.
[*]Also makes sure the player gets the achievement if they quit during the end sequence.
[*]Moved the game completion achievement to the start of the end sequence for the same reason. 
[/list]

notes.title: Captain MaCaw 75% off!
notes.content:
Captain MaCaw is currently 75% off in the steam summer sale!

Also, update 1.1 incoming in the next week or 2.

Highlights include:-

[list]
[*] New locations.
[*] New NPC's.
[*] New Puzzles.
[*] New achievements.
[*] Some locations redesigned to improve game flow.
[*] All text re done to look truer to the ZX spectrum!
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.002
notes.content:
Very small update to address a bug that was reported.
It allowed you to bypass a cartain puzzle if you were playing on a joypad.
It did not halt progress, quite the opposite actually.
It allowed quicker progression.
Fixed in this build.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Tiny hotfix deployed to resolve a graphical issue where the Xbox Y button was still visible when there was no save file to load.

notes.title: Beta 5 Released
notes.content:
Beta 5 has now been uploaded which is mainly bug fixes but a few additions to enhance the player experience.

[list]
[*] All title screen options bar define keys, for obvious reasons, can now be selected with the joypad.
[*] The intro can be skipped.
[*] You can call the quit menu from the joypad with the back button.
[*] You can now press escape/back to close the quit menu.
[*] Title screen redesigned slightly to show the joypad controls.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 4
notes.content:
Beta 4 released.

Bar finding any new major issues, this should be the final beta before release.

[list]
[*] Intro music in
[*] New Achievement in
[*] Various bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 3 Released
notes.content:
Beta 3 ready for download.

[list]
[*] Teleporters between 2 points to reduce back tracking now in.
[*]  End credits in.
[/list]


Game is almost ready to go gold and I anticipate a release earlier than 18/02/2019.

notes.title: Beta 2
notes.content:
Beta 2 has been uploaded.
Patch notes as below.

Beta 3 coming soon with added quick travel feature.

[list]
[*] Graphics doors that open re coloured to be the correct shade of black.
[*] 1 achievement tweaked to make it more obvious. (no spoiler)
[*] Progress stopping bug 2/3 the way through the game resolved.
[*] Music bug where in game music over played the end sequence music resolved.
[*] Several text issues resolved.
[*] Several graphical issues resolved.
[/list]

notes.title: First Beta Released
notes.content:
The first beta for Captain MaCaw has been released.


[list]
[*] Game completable from start to finish.
[*] 10 Achievements in.
[*] Graphics polished in some areas (as much as you can polish low res speccy graphics!)
[*] Instructions, intro and start sequences in
[/list]

This is now with beta testers to find any outstanding issues but we are very much on target for Feb 18th release date.

More to follow!
